bedrooms.title: 黑房间
bedrooms.blurb: 窗帘把白天关在门外。墙是暗的，钟是懒的。
bedrooms.blurbEn: Curtains keep daylight outside. The walls stay dim; the clock stays lazy.

bedrooms.title: 蒙古包夜
bedrooms.blurb: 圆顶漏一点月亮。风在毡外走，人不跟着走。
bedrooms.blurbEn: A round roof lets a little moon in. Wind walks outside the felt; the sleeper does not follow.

bedrooms.title: 竹帘午睡
bedrooms.blurb: 百叶把午后切成细条。风从缝里来，人从缝里睡。
bedrooms.blurbEn: Shutters slice the afternoon into thin bars. Wind arrives through the gaps; so does the nap.

bedrooms.title: 胶囊舱
bedrooms.blurb: 舱灯很淡。门一关，走廊的拖鞋声就变成别人的故事。
bedrooms.blurbEn: The cabin lamp is faint. Close the hatch and the hallway slippers become someone else's story.

bedrooms.title: 卧铺隔间
bedrooms.blurb: 夜灯贴着墙。帘子一拉，整节车厢变成许多小夜。
bedrooms.blurbEn: A nightlight hugs the wall. Pull the curtain and the car becomes many small nights.

bedrooms.title: 四合院耳房
bedrooms.blurb: 耳房贴着厢房睡。院子里的月亮到不了枕头，只到门槛。
bedrooms.blurbEn: A side chamber sleeps against the wing. Moonlight from the courtyard reaches the threshold, not the pillow.

bedrooms.title: 炕房
bedrooms.blurb: 整面墙是床。灯灭以后，砖还记得白天的火。
bedrooms.blurbEn: A whole wall is the bed. After the lamp dies, the brick still remembers the day's fire.

bedrooms.title: 和室
bedrooms.blurb: 纸门把光磨软。叠好的被是一座矮山，等夜里再摊开。
bedrooms.blurbEn: Paper doors sand the light down. A folded futon waits as a low hill, to open again at night.

bedrooms.title: 北欧木屋
bedrooms.blurb: 木头吞掉风声。窗外是长夜，窗内是一小块暖。
bedrooms.blurbEn: Timber swallows the wind. Outside is a long night; inside is a small square of warmth.

bedrooms.title: 夜灯房
bedrooms.blurb: 夜灯只够看清拖鞋。凹室把床藏进墙，呼吸声被墙接住。
bedrooms.blurbEn: The nightlight is only bright enough for slippers. An alcove hides the bed; the wall catches the breath.
